1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Kebajikan Haiwan (Fi Pelesenan) 2021.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Julai 2021.

Pengeluaran lesen

2. Jika suatu permohonan lesen itu diluluskan oleh Lembaga, Lembaga hendaklah

mengeluarkan lesen atas nama pemohon apabila dibayar fi yang dinyatakan

dalam Jadual.

Pembaharuan lesen

3. Jika suatu permohonan untuk suatu pembaharuan lesen diluluskan oleh

Lembaga, lesen itu hendaklah diperbaharui apabila dibayar fi yang dinyatakan

dalam Jadual.

Penggantian lesen

4. (1) Seseorang pemegang lesen boleh memohon untuk penggantian lesennya

kepada Lembaga jika lesennya hilang, musnah atau rosak.

(2) Suatu permohonan di bawah subperaturan (1) hendaklah dibuat kepada

Lembaga dengan mengemukakan suatu permohonan bertulis dalam apa-apa bentuk

dan mengikut cara yang ditentukan oleh Lembaga.

(3) Lembaga boleh, selepas menerima permohonan bagi penggantian lesen

di bawah subperaturan (1), mengeluarkan lesen ganti untuk menggantikan lesen asal.

ANIMAL WELFARE ACT 2015

ANIMAL WELFARE (FEES OF LICENSING) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 62(2)(i) and (j) of the

Animal Welfare Act 2015 [Act 772], the Minister, after consulting the Board, makes the

following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Animal Welfare (Fees of Licensing)

Regulations 2021.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 July 2021.

Issuance of licence

2. Where an application for a licence is approved by the Board, the Board shall issue

a licence in the name of the applicant upon payment of the fee as specified

in the Schedule.

Renewal of licence

3. Where an application for renewal of a licence is approved by the Board, the licence

shall be renewed upon payment of the fee as specified in the Schedule.

Replacement of licence

4. (1) A licensee may apply for a replacement of his licence to the Board if his

licence is lost, destroyed or damaged.

(2) An application under subregulation (1) shall be made to the Board by

submitting a written application in any form and manner as determined by the Board.

(3) The Board may, after receiving the application for a replacement of licence

under subregulation (1), issue a replacement licence to replace the original licence.
